Title: Learn how to manage and optimize your Azure costs with our guided learning modules

Body.Content:
Azure Cost Management gives you the tools to analyze, manage and optimize your cloud expenditure. Sharpen your cost management skills by attending these courses below.

Azure Cost Management Learning Path

Course: Cost Optimization

Course: Predict costs and optimize spending

Course: Analyze costs and create budgets

Course: Save money with Azure Reserved Instances

Course: Configure and manage costs as a Microsoft partner
